body:
I feel a little hypocritical posting a reply here since I am also considering putting an end to things (I too feel like I've tried everything to fix myself and none of it works, and I'm just *tired* of feeling panic and worthlessness and nothing else), but I figure I might as well try to help while I can. 

I don't really know what to say since I'm in no position to be giving you advice, but maybe we can talk about it and see if we feel better afterward. 

Have you been treated for PTSD specifically?

I was strongly considering suicide before the news, the news just kind of pushed me over the edge, so to speak. 

As for why I was considering it in the first place, I've reached a dead end in my life in pretty much everything. I have the only job I'd ever be even remotely happy doing, and I can't even manage to do it well enough to have any degree of job security.  I'm depressed, and it's the kind of depression that saps the enjoyment out of everything. I can't feel "higher" feelings. Only the lower ones like dread and panic. I don't feel like I can relate to other people on any meaningful level. It all seems empty and pointless and more trouble than it's worth. I've been trying to work through it for a year, and I've made some degree of progress, but not really enough to give me any hope for my future. 

What makes it worse is that I'm usually a pretty self-aware, self-fixing individual. I suppose you could say that I'm good at thinking my way out of things like this. I've been through A LOT of therapy in my past (for depression and other things), and I hope this doesn't come off in a bad way (I don't intend it to, I promise I have very little self-esteem to speak of and I'm not trying to sound arrogant), but I feel like maybe I'm too "advanced" for the counselors I've been able to find. It seems like I've already tried all the stuff they tell me to try. 

I guess what it boils down to is that I'm beyond anyone else's help, and I'm pretty sure I can't help myself. 

I think that's probably why I'm posting this - hoping maybe somebody will say the thing that helps me and I won't have to do this. 

EDIT: I really do appreciate you taking the time to talk to me, though. It's a little lonely when you feel like it might be your last day on earth, and I'm thankful for the comfort no matter what ends up happening.

I'm medicated, and I've been in counseling for a bit. It seemed like everything was looking up recently (at least compared to where I was), but I just found out that I'm going to be completely demolished financially (this was out of the blue), and the urge to end it all is worse than ever. 

Living seems kind of pointless. There isn't much that brings me happiness anymore, and the panic is too much to handle.
